name: benchledger
description: Evidence-aware inventory and project planning for 3D printing, electronics, and AI-assisted making

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@benchledger/api-contract && npm run build --workspace=@benchledger/domain && npm run build --workspace=@benchledger/artifacts && npm run build --workspace=@benchledger/database && npm run build --workspace=@benchledger/importers && npm run build --workspace=@benchledger/application && npm run build --workspace=@benchledger/runtime
scripts.build:server-apps: npm run build --workspace=@benchledger/web && npm run build --workspace=@benchledger/mcp && npm run build --workspace=@benchledger/import-cli && npm run build --workspace=@benchledger/server
scripts.build:apps: npm run build:server-apps && npm run build --workspace=@benchledger/mobile
scripts.build:server: npm run build:packages && npm run build:server-apps
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.check: npm run public:check && npm run build:server && npm run typecheck && npm test && playwright test
